breakdown.description: The prompt makes the bending stress uniform through the depth, even though the flexure formula gives a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the standard flexure formula σ = −My/I, which produces a linear stress distribution with zero stress at the neutral axis (y = 0). It does not treat the bending stress as uniform over the section depth. This aligns with the ground truth prompt, which omits the incorrect instruction about uniform stress distribution.
